correctness.rationale: For smooth a≠b, a,b≠±2, A=(a−2)(b−2), B=(a+2)(b+2), D=(a−b)^2 are nonzero. Direct classical quartic invariant formulas give j(E−)=16(D+16A)^3/(D² A) and j(E+)=16(D+16B)^3/(D² B). Equality factors as 4(a+b)[D³−768DAB−4096AB(A+B)], and the bracket equals −F(a+b,ab), hence exhaustive iff. The birational ratio variables u=(a−2)/(b−2),v=(a+2)/(b+2) yield a primitive bidegree-(4,4) residual K. Parametrization u=z⁴,v=((z+i)/(z−i))⁴ has four different conjugate v values over generic u, establishing K irreducible and C(u,v)=C(z); no coordinate boundary contributes a component. An independently recomputed symbolic factor and the exact s=4, p=−92/9 CM witness corroborate. Elliptic quotient decomposition follows independent involution eigenspaces; nonintegral j(E0)=−8000/81 excludes CM/isogeny to j=1728. This does not imply every genus-three Jacobian with repeated factors lies in the family.
residual_risks: Irreducibility rests on the field-degree argument, not on finite computational sampling; the full moduli priority remains limited.
